name: Kabzda
summary:
Kabzda is a Ukrainian online multiplayer economic strategy and board game inspired by classic property-trading mechanics. Set in a modern Ukrainian business universe, players compete across a 40-tile board featuring 28 Ukrainian companies divided into 10 economic sectors - ranging from coffee shops, postal logistics, and retail networks to fintech banks, AI startups, energy grids, and sea ports.

The game features live timed property auctions, smart trade contracts between players, 32 Ukrainian event cards ("Digital Push UA" and "Unity Fund"), a 2v2 Alliance team mode with shared monopolies, and voiced AI opponents (Pan Lev, Lesia, and Taras) with three difficulty levels. Playable directly in modern web browsers on desktop and mobile devices.
